panels.title: RVs
panels.description: Current matching RVs.

panels.title: Auto RVs
panels.description: Current matching RVs with configurationMode=Auto (configuration derived from the ReplicatedStorageClass).

panels.title: Manual RVs
panels.description: Current matching RVs with configurationMode=Manual (configuration set in the RV spec, no storage class). Manual RVs have storage_class="unknown", so selecting a specific storage class shows 0.

panels.title: Not Ready RVs
panels.description: Volumes whose Ready condition is not True, excluding volumes that are still forming (reason Forming, or Absent: no status published yet): these volumes do not serve IO. Deleting volumes are not counted. See Problem Volumes for the list.

panels.title: Not Resilient RVs
panels.description: Volumes whose Resilient condition is not True, excluding volumes that are still forming (reason Forming or Absent): they serve IO (if Ready) but would not survive the intended number of failures. Deleting volumes are not counted.

panels.title: Attachment Not Ready RVs
panels.description: Volumes whose AttachedReady condition is not True: an established attachment is failed, has suspended IO, or is in an unknown state. Volumes without attachments are not counted. Deleting volumes are not counted.

panels.title: Deleting RVs
panels.description: Scrape-time count of RVs with deletionTimestamp. Short deletes can happen between scrapes; sustained non-zero values likely mean deletion is stuck.

panels.title: Under Maintenance RVs
panels.description: Volumes with the UnderMaintenance condition set: every action on them is stopped by spec.maintenance. Deleting volumes are not counted.

panels.title: RV Not Ready by Reason
panels.description: Volumes whose Ready condition is not True, stacked by reason. Forming is a volume being created, Absent one without any status yet; QuorumLost, StatusUnknown and AttachmentNotReady mean the volume does not serve IO. Deleting volumes are not counted; Absent means the condition is not set yet.

panels.title: RV Not Resilient by Reason
panels.description: Volumes whose Resilient condition is not True, stacked by reason. Degraded means effective redundancy is below the intended one. Deleting volumes are not counted; Absent means the condition is not set yet.

panels.title: RV Other Conditions Not True
panels.description: Volumes with other conditions not True, stacked by condition and reason: AttachedReady, MembershipLayoutConverged, ConfigurationReady, Configured, Scheduled, SatisfyEligibleNodes. Short spikes of Configured/Scheduled/Converging are normal during creation and layout changes. Deleting volumes are not counted; Absent means the condition is not set yet.

panels.title: Not Ready Volumes
panels.description: Volumes whose Ready condition is not True, longest first. Forming volumes are listed too, and volumes with no status published yet (status and reason Absent, Since is the creation time): a long Duration means stuck creation. Since is the last status change of the condition: a reason change within the same status keeps it, a change between False and Unknown moves it, so Duration may be shorter than the problem. storage_class="unknown" means a Manual volume (Manual volumes have no storage class). Per-volume series have no node label, so the Node selector does not apply.

targets.expr: time() - max by (name, storage_class, status, reason) (sds_rv_condition_problem_timestamp_seconds{storage_class=~"$storage_class",condition="Ready"})

panels.title: Not Resilient Volumes
panels.description: Volumes whose Resilient condition is not True, longest first. Since is the last status change of the condition: a reason change within the same status keeps it, a change between False and Unknown moves it, so Duration may be shorter than the problem. storage_class="unknown" means a Manual volume (Manual volumes have no storage class). Per-volume series have no node label, so the Node selector does not apply.

targets.expr: time() - max by (name, storage_class, status, reason) (sds_rv_condition_problem_timestamp_seconds{storage_class=~"$storage_class",condition="Resilient"})

panels.title: Other Condition Problems
panels.description: Volumes with AttachedReady, MembershipLayoutConverged or ConfigurationReady not True, or with UnderMaintenance set, longest first. MembershipLayoutConverged with CannotConverge or TransitionUnsupported needs manual intervention (alert D8ReplicatedVolumeLayoutDegraded). Since is the last status change of the condition: a reason change within the same status keeps it, a change between False and Unknown moves it, so Duration may be shorter than the problem. storage_class="unknown" means a Manual volume (Manual volumes have no storage class). Per-volume series have no node label, so the Node selector does not apply.

targets.expr: max by (name, storage_class, condition, status, reason) (sds_rv_condition_problem_timestamp_seconds{storage_class=~"$storage_class",condition=~"AttachedReady|MembershipLayoutConverged|ConfigurationReady|UnderMaintenance"}) * 1000

time() - max by (name, storage_class, condition, status, reason) (sds_rv_condition_problem_timestamp_seconds{storage_class=~"$storage_class",condition=~"AttachedReady|MembershipLayoutConverged|ConfigurationReady|UnderMaintenance"})

panels.title: Deleting Volumes
panels.description: Volumes being deleted, longest first. Since is the deletion timestamp; a long Duration means stuck deletion. storage_class="unknown" means a Manual volume (Manual volumes have no storage class). Per-volume series have no node label, so the Node selector does not apply.

panels.title: Raw Capacity
panels.description: Total capacity of the storage pool of each class, before replication. Thick (LVM) pools count the size and free space of their volume groups; thin (LVMThin) pools count the allocation limit of their thin pools (thin pool size x allocationLimit of the LVMVolumeGroup), and free space is that limit minus the space allocated to thin volumes. Classes sharing a pool show the same value.

targets.expr: (sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_size_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""})) or sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""}))) * on (storage_pool) group_right group by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

panels.title: Raw Free
panels.description: Free capacity of the storage pool of each class, before replication. Thick (LVM) pools count the size and free space of their volume groups; thin (LVMThin) pools count the allocation limit of their thin pools (thin pool size x allocationLimit of the LVMVolumeGroup), and free space is that limit minus the space allocated to thin volumes.

targets.expr: (sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_free_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""})) or sum by (storage_pool) (clamp_min(max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) - max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes), 0) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""}))) * on (storage_pool) group_right group by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

panels.title: Raw Used
panels.description: Share of the capacity of the storage pool of each class that is taken. For thin pools it is the share of the allocation limit allocated to thin volumes, not the share of the thin pool filled with data (see the thin pool panel).

targets.expr: (1 - (sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_free_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""})) or sum by (storage_pool) (clamp_min(max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) - max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes), 0) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""}))) / (sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_size_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""})) or sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""})))) * on (storage_pool) group_right group by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

panels.title: Usable Capacity
panels.description: Raw capacity divided by the number of replicas of the class: how much volume data the pool holds for the class. Usable capacity is raw capacity divided by the number of diskful replicas of the class (failuresToTolerate + guaranteedMinimumDataRedundancy + 1, sds_rsc_replicas). It is an upper bound: replicas of one volume are placed on different nodes and each fits into one volume group, so with unevenly filled nodes less can actually be placed.

targets.expr: (sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_size_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""})) or sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""}))) / on (storage_pool) group_right max by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

panels.title: Usable Free
panels.description: Raw free capacity divided by the number of replicas of the class: roughly how much more volume data the class can take. Usable capacity is raw capacity divided by the number of diskful replicas of the class (failuresToTolerate + guaranteedMinimumDataRedundancy + 1, sds_rsc_replicas). It is an upper bound: replicas of one volume are placed on different nodes and each fits into one volume group, so with unevenly filled nodes less can actually be placed.

targets.expr: (sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_free_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""})) or sum by (storage_pool) (clamp_min(max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) - max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes), 0) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""}))) / on (storage_pool) group_right max by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description: Number of diskful replicas of the volumes of each class (failuresToTolerate + guaranteedMinimumDataRedundancy + 1) from its accepted configuration; usable capacity is raw capacity divided by it.

panels.title: Free Capacity by Storage Class
panels.description: Raw and usable free capacity of the storage pool of each class over time. Thick (LVM) pools count the size and free space of their volume groups; thin (LVMThin) pools count the allocation limit of their thin pools (thin pool size x allocationLimit of the LVMVolumeGroup), and free space is that limit minus the space allocated to thin volumes. Usable capacity is raw capacity divided by the number of diskful replicas of the class (failuresToTolerate + guaranteedMinimumDataRedundancy + 1, sds_rsc_replicas). It is an upper bound: replicas of one volume are placed on different nodes and each fits into one volume group, so with unevenly filled nodes less can actually be placed.

targets.expr: (sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_free_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""})) or sum by (storage_pool) (clamp_min(max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) - max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes), 0) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""}))) * on (storage_pool) group_right group by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

(sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_free_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""})) or sum by (storage_pool) (clamp_min(max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) - max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes), 0) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""}))) / on (storage_pool) group_right max by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

panels.title: Thin Pools: Allocation and Data by Storage Class
panels.description: Thin (LVMThin) pools of each class, summed over the pool: Allocated is the space allocated to thin volumes, Allocation Limit is the thin pool size multiplied by allocationLimit of the LVMVolumeGroup (new volumes are refused above it), Data Used is the space actually written, and Pool Size is the physical size of the thin pools. Data Used close to Pool Size means the thin pools are about to run out of space whatever the allocation limit allows. Thick classes have no series here.

targets.expr: sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""})) * on (storage_pool) group_right group by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""})) * on (storage_pool) group_right group by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_used_size_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""})) * on (storage_pool) group_right group by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

sum by (storage_pool) (max by (lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_actual_size_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""})) * on (storage_pool) group_right group by (storage_class, storage_pool) (sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"})

panels.title: Capacity by Node / LVMVolumeGroup
panels.description: Every LVMVolumeGroup (and thin pool) of the storage pools of the selected classes. Thick (LVM) pools count the size and free space of their volume groups; thin (LVMThin) pools count the allocation limit of their thin pools (thin pool size x allocationLimit of the LVMVolumeGroup), and free space is that limit minus the space allocated to thin volumes. Used is the share of that capacity taken; Thin Data Used is the share of the thin pool filled with data. An LVMVolumeGroup listed in several pools has a row per pool. Capacity is reported by the sds-node-configurator agent, so a node whose agent is not scraped has no row.

targets.expr: (max by (node, lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_size_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right (node) max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""}) or max by (node, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right (node) max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""})) and on (storage_pool) sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"}

(max by (node, lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_free_bytes) * on (lvg_name) group_right (node) max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""}) or clamp_min(max by (node, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) - max by (node, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes), 0) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right (node) max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""})) and on (storage_pool) sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"}

((1 - max by (node, lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_free_bytes) / max by (node, lvg_name) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_size_bytes)) * on (lvg_name) group_right (node) max by (storage_pool, lvg_name) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool=""}) or (1 - clamp_min(max by (node, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) - max by (node, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes), 0) / max by (node, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes)) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right (node) max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""})) and on (storage_pool) sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"}

(max by (node, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_used_size_bytes) / max by (node, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_actual_size_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_right (node) max by (storage_pool, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_rsp_lvg_info{thin_pool!=""})) and on (storage_pool) sds_rsc_replicas{storage_class=~"$storage_class"}

panels.title: RVs Created
panels.description: RVs created over the selected dashboard range (counted once, when the controller adds its finalizer). The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (increase/rate need two samples). Volumes taken over from LINSTOR by the migration are counted here too, so a migration shows up as a burst of created RVs.

panels.title: RVs Formed
panels.description: RVs that completed initial formation over the selected dashboard range. The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (increase/rate need two samples).

panels.title: RVs Deleted
panels.description: RVs whose deletion completed over the selected dashboard range. The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (increase/rate need two samples).

panels.title: Formation Duration Avg
panels.description: Average RV initial formation time over the selected dashboard range. Uses completed RV initial formation observations only.

panels.title: Formation Duration P90
panels.description: P90 RV initial formation time over the selected dashboard range. Uses completed RV initial formation observations only.

panels.title: RVs Forming Now
panels.description: RVs whose Ready condition currently has reason Forming (created but not yet formed, or formation restarted) or is absent (no status published yet, e.g. the storage pool does not exist). A value that stays above zero with no RVs formed means formation is stuck; see Not Ready Volumes for the list.

panels.title: RV Throughput
panels.description: RVs created, formed and deleted per minute (rate over $__rate_interval). Zero while volumes are forming or deleting (see the panel on the right) means the control plane is stuck. Use the RVs Created/Formed/Deleted tiles for totals. The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (increase/rate need two samples). Volumes taken over from LINSTOR by the migration are counted here too, so a migration shows up as a burst of created RVs.

panels.title: RVs Forming / Deleting Now
panels.description: RVs currently forming (Ready reason Forming or Ready absent) and currently being deleted. A backlog that grows while RV Throughput stays flat means the control plane does not keep up or is stuck.

panels.title: RV Initial Formation Duration P90
panels.description: P90 time from RV creation to first completed initial datamesh formation. Completion is detected like CSI readiness: datameshRevision > 0 and no active Formation transition.

panels.title: RV Initial Formation Duration Bands
panels.description: Completed RV initial formation observations: healthy <=10s, slow >10s and <=30s, too slow >30s. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

panels.title: Active Datamesh Transitions by Type
panels.description: Datamesh transitions currently in progress, stacked by type.

panels.title: Oldest Active Transition Age by Type
panels.description: Age of the oldest active datamesh transition of each type (since its start). A steadily growing line means a stuck transition. The value is how long the oldest one has lasted so far; the series disappears when nothing is left.

panels.title: Oldest Deleting Object Age by Kind / Node
panels.description: Age of the oldest RV/RVR/RVA being deleted (since its deletionTimestamp), by node; RVs have node="global". A steadily growing line means stuck deletion; see Deleting Volumes for the RV list. The value is how long the oldest one has lasted so far; the series disappears when nothing is left.

panels.title: Oldest Not Ready RVR Age by Node / Phase
panels.description: How long the longest non-Ready replica has been non-Ready, by node and phase (deleting replicas excluded). Points to the node where replicas do not start or do not recover. The value is how long the oldest one has lasted so far; the series disappears when nothing is left.

panels.title: RVRs
panels.description: Current matching RVRs.

panels.title: RVAs
panels.description: Current matching RVAs.

panels.title: Unhealthy RVRs
panels.description: Current RVRs in degraded-like phases.

panels.title: Deleting RVRs
panels.description: Scrape-time count of RVRs with deletionTimestamp. Short deletes can happen between scrapes; sustained non-zero values likely mean deletion is stuck.

panels.title: RV Count by Storage Class
panels.description: Current RV count by storage class plus total. Manual volumes have no storage class and are shown as a separate "Manual" series.

panels.title: RVR Count by Storage Class
panels.description: Current RVR count by storage class plus total. Node selector still filters the scope, but the graph does not split series by node. Series with storage_class="unknown" belong to Manual volumes (they have no storage class).

panels.title: RVA Count by Storage Class
panels.description: Current RVA count by storage class plus total. Node selector still filters the scope, but the graph does not split series by node. Series with storage_class="unknown" belong to Manual volumes (they have no storage class).

panels.title: RVR Count by Node
panels.description: Current RVR counts by node and storage class. Series with storage_class="unknown" belong to Manual volumes (they have no storage class).

panels.title: RVA Count by Node
panels.description: Current RVA counts by node and storage class. Series with storage_class="unknown" belong to Manual volumes (they have no storage class).

panels.title: RVR Count by Node / Phase
panels.description: Current non-zero RVR count split by node, storage class, and phase. Controlled by the RVR Phase selector. Series with storage_class="unknown" belong to Manual volumes (they have no storage class).

panels.title: RVA Count by Node / Phase
panels.description: Current non-zero RVA count split by node, storage class, and phase. Controlled by the RVA Phase selector. Series with storage_class="unknown" belong to Manual volumes (they have no storage class).

panels.title: RVR Ready Lost per Minute by Node / Reason
panels.description: Replicas that lost Ready (condition went from True to False or Unknown) per minute, by node and by the reason they lost it (Absent: the condition disappeared). Deleting replicas and planned DRBD configuration changes (reason ApplyingConfiguration, see the neighbouring panel) are not shown. A node that stands out points to a node, agent or network problem. Per minute: rate over $__rate_interval times 60, so values are a rate and are not summed over time. The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (rate needs two samples).

panels.title: RVR Ready Lost on Configuration Apply per Minute
panels.description: Replicas that lost Ready while the agent was applying a new DRBD configuration (reason ApplyingConfiguration) per minute, by node. Usually a planned change such as a resize, a quorum change or a membership change: Ready drops while the agent has not confirmed the change and returns within seconds. A sustained rate without planned changes may point to configuration churn. Per minute: rate over $__rate_interval times 60, so values are a rate and are not summed over time. The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (rate needs two samples).

panels.title: Deleting RVR Current Count by Node and Storage Class
panels.description: Scrape-time count of RVRs with deletionTimestamp by node and storage class. Short deletes can happen between scrapes; sustained non-zero values likely mean deletion is stuck.

panels.title: Backing Volume P90
panels.description: P90 LLV provisioning time (LVMLogicalVolume creation -> BackingVolumeReady, once per provisioned LLV) over the selected dashboard range; thresholds match the healthy/slow/too slow bands below. No data means there were no completed operations in the range.

panels.title: DRBDR Configured P90
panels.description: P90 time from DRBDResource creation to its first Configured=True over the selected dashboard range; thresholds match the healthy/slow/too slow bands below. No data means there were no completed operations in the range.

panels.title: RVA Ready P90
panels.description: P90 time from RVA creation to its first Ready (attach) over the selected dashboard range; thresholds match the healthy/slow/too slow bands below. No data means there were no completed operations in the range.

panels.title: RVA Detach P90
panels.description: P90 RVA detach time over the selected dashboard range; thresholds match the healthy/slow/too slow bands below. No data means there were no completed operations in the range.

panels.title: RVR Deletion P90
panels.description: P90 time from RVR deletionTimestamp to finalizer removal over the selected dashboard range; thresholds match the healthy/slow/too slow bands below. No data means there were no completed operations in the range.

panels.title: RV Deletion P90
panels.description: P90 time from RV deletionTimestamp to finalizer removal over the selected dashboard range; thresholds match the healthy/slow/too slow bands below. No data means there were no completed operations in the range.

panels.title: RVR Backing Volume Duration P90
panels.description: P90 LLV provisioning time: LVMLogicalVolume creation -> BackingVolumeReady, once per provisioned LLV (resize and temporary NotReady are not counted). No data means there were no completed operations in the selected range.

panels.title: RVR Backing Volume Provisioned per Minute
panels.description: LLVs provisioned (BackingVolumeReady after provisioning) per minute, by node and for the cluster. Compare with RVR phases to see whether provisioning is moving. Per minute: rate over $__rate_interval times 60, so values are a rate and are not summed over time. The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (rate needs two samples).

panels.title: RVR Backing Volume Duration Bands
panels.description: LLV provisioning time (LVMLogicalVolume creation -> BackingVolumeReady, once per provisioned LLV): healthy <=5s, slow >5s and <=20s, too slow >20s. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

panels.title: DRBDResource Configured Duration P90
panels.description: Time from DRBDResource creation to its first Configured=True (later reconfigurations are not counted). This includes agent reconcile latency, DRBD configuration, and status update latency; it is not raw DRBD runtime replication state.

panels.title: DRBDResource Configured per Minute
panels.description: DRBDResources that reached their first Configured=True per minute, by node and for the cluster. Per minute: rate over $__rate_interval times 60, so values are a rate and are not summed over time.

panels.title: DRBDResource Configured Duration Bands
panels.description: DRBDResource creation -> first Configured=True, cluster-wide (per-node view: P90 and per-minute panels). Healthy <=2s, slow >2s and <=10s, too slow >10s. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

panels.title: RVA Ready / Detach Duration P90
panels.description: RVA attach and detach duration by node. No data means there were no completed operations in the selected range.

panels.title: RVA Ready / Detach per Minute
panels.description: Completed RVA attaches (first Ready) and detaches per minute, by node and for the cluster. Per minute: rate over $__rate_interval times 60, so values are a rate and are not summed over time. The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (rate needs two samples).

panels.title: RVA Ready Duration Bands
panels.description: Completed RVA attach observations: healthy <=10s, slow >10s and <=30s, too slow >30s. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

panels.title: RVA Detach Duration Bands
panels.description: Completed RVA detach observations: healthy <=5s, slow >5s and <=30s, too slow >30s. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

panels.title: RVR Deletion Duration P90
panels.description: P90 and average time from RVR deletionTimestamp to finalizer removal, including per-node RVR p90. No data means there were no completed RVR deletions in the selected range.

panels.title: RVR Deletion Completed per Minute
panels.description: Completed RVR deletions per minute, by node and for the cluster. A growing Deleting RVRs count with a low rate here points to stuck deletion. Per minute: rate over $__rate_interval times 60, so values are a rate and are not summed over time. The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (rate needs two samples).

panels.title: RVR Deletion Duration Bands
panels.description: Completed RVR deletion observations: healthy <=10s, slow >10s and <=60s, too slow >60s. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

panels.title: DRBDResource Deletion Duration P90
panels.description: Time from DRBDResource deletionTimestamp to agent finalizer removal. Shows agent-side DRBDResource cleanup duration separately from overall RVR deletion time.

panels.title: DRBDResource Deletion Completed per Minute
panels.description: Completed DRBDResource deletions (deletionTimestamp -> agent finalizer removed) per minute, by node and for the cluster. Per minute: rate over $__rate_interval times 60, so values are a rate and are not summed over time.

panels.title: DRBDResource Deletion Duration Bands
panels.description: Completed DRBDResource deletions (deletionTimestamp -> agent finalizer removed), cluster-wide (per-node view: P90 and per-minute panels); healthy <=5s, slow >5s and <=30s, too slow >30s. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

panels.title: RV Deletion Duration P90
panels.description: P90 and average time from RV deletionTimestamp to finalizer removal. No data means there were no completed RV deletions in the selected range.

panels.title: RV Deletion Duration Bands
panels.description: Completed RV deletion observations: healthy <=10s, slow >10s and <=60s, too slow >60s. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

panels.title: Datamesh Transitions Completed per Minute by Type
panels.description: Completed datamesh transitions per minute, by type and for the cluster. Per minute: rate over $__rate_interval times 60, so values are a rate and are not summed over time. The first event of a series that appeared after a controller restart is not counted (rate needs two samples).

panels.title: Datamesh Transition Duration P90 by Type
panels.description: P90 datamesh transition duration by type, with the cluster P90 and average. No data means there were no completed transitions in the selected range.

panels.title: Datamesh Step Duration P90 by Step
panels.description: P90 and average datamesh step duration by step name (steps of all selected transition types). No data means there were no completed steps in the selected range.

panels.title: Datamesh Transition Duration Bands by Type
panels.description: Completed datamesh transitions by type: healthy <=5s, slow >5s and <=30s, too slow >30s. Use the transition_type filter to reduce noise. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

panels.title: Datamesh Step Duration Bands by Type and Step
panels.description: Completed Datamesh steps by type and step: healthy <=5s, slow >5s and <=30s, too slow >30s. Use filters to reduce noise. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead.

targets.expr: clamp_min((sum by (type, step) (increase(sds_rv_datamesh_step_duration_seconds_bucket{storage_class=~"$storage_class",node=~"$node|global|unknown",type=~"$transition_type",le="30"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (type, step) (increase(sds_rv_datamesh_step_duration_seconds_bucket{storage_class=~"$storage_class",node=~"$node|global|unknown",type=~"$transition_type",le="5"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)

clamp_min((sum by (type, step) (increase(sds_rv_datamesh_step_duration_seconds_bucket{storage_class=~"$storage_class",node=~"$node|global|unknown",type=~"$transition_type",le="+Inf"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (type, step) (increase(sds_rv_datamesh_step_duration_seconds_bucket{storage_class=~"$storage_class",node=~"$node|global|unknown",type=~"$transition_type",le="30"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)

panels.title: Disconnected DRBD Resources
panels.description: DRBD resources with at least one connection not in Connected state. In the new control plane a DRBD resource is one replica (RVR), so this counts replicas, not volumes.

panels.title: DRBD Resources Without Quorum
panels.description: DRBD resources (replicas) with a device that has lost quorum. IO on such a replica is blocked.

panels.title: DRBD Resources With Storage Failure
panels.description: DRBD resources (replicas) whose device became diskless unintentionally, i.e. the backing volume failed or was detached.

panels.title: IO Suspended DRBD Resources
panels.description: DRBD resources with IO suspended (for example, on quorum loss with on-no-quorum=suspend-io): IO to them hangs instead of failing. In the new control plane a DRBD resource is one replica (RVR), so this counts replicas, not volumes.

panels.title: Out-of-Sync DRBD Resources
panels.description: DRBD resources (replicas) that have out-of-sync data towards at least one peer. Expected briefly during resync.

panels.title: Out-of-Sync Data
panels.description: Total amount of out-of-sync data, taking the worst peer per DRBD device.

targets.expr: sum(max by (name, volume) (drbd_peerdevice_outofsync_bytes{node=~"$node"} > 0)) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: DRBD Runtime Problem Count
panels.description: Current DRBD runtime problems from DRBD exporter: bad connection state, missing quorum, unintentionally diskless devices, and suspended IO. Shows DRBD exporter runtime state separately from DRBDResource CR lifecycle.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (drbd_connection_state{node=~"$node",drbd_connection_state!="UpToDate",drbd_connection_state!="Connected"} == 1) or on(node) (0 * sum by (node) (drbd_connection_state{node=~"$node"}))
sum by (node) (drbd_device_quorum{node=~"$node"} == 0) or on(node) (0 * sum by (node) (drbd_device_quorum{node=~"$node"}))
sum by (node) (drbd_device_unintentionaldiskless{node=~"$node"} == 1) or on(node) (0 * sum by (node) (drbd_device_unintentionaldiskless{node=~"$node"}))
sum by (node) (drbd_resource_suspended{node=~"$node"} == 1) or on(node) (0 * sum by (node) (drbd_resource_suspended{node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: DRBD Runtime Out-of-Sync Bytes
panels.description: Existing DRBD exporter metric aligned with DRBD alert rules. Non-zero values indicate replication lag. Shows DRBD exporter runtime state separately from DRBDResource CR lifecycle.

panels.title: Disconnected DRBD Resources
panels.description: DRBD connections that are not in Connected state. Same selection as alert D8DrbdDeviceIsNotConnected.

panels.title: Out-of-Sync DRBD Resources
panels.description: DRBD peer devices with out-of-sync data. Same selection as alert D8DrbdPeerDeviceIsOutOfSync.

panels.title: DRBD Resources Without Quorum
panels.description: DRBD devices without quorum. Same selection as alert D8DrbdDeviceHasNoQuorum.

panels.title: DRBD Resources With Storage Failure
panels.description: Unintentionally diskless DRBD devices. Same selection as alert D8DrbdDeviceIsUnintentionalDiskless.

panels.title: IO Suspended DRBD Resources
panels.description: DRBD resources with IO suspended: IO to them hangs instead of failing.

panels.title: DRBD Devices Not UpToDate
panels.description: DRBD devices whose local disk is neither UpToDate nor Diskless (Outdated, Inconsistent, Failed, Attaching, ...): the replica cannot serve as a source of current data right now. Diskless devices (diskless replicas and tie-breakers) are not listed; an unexpected loss of the disk is in DRBD Resources With Storage Failure.

panels.title: DRBD Write Rate (Top-5 Devices)
panels.description: Write rate of the 5 most active DRBD devices at each point in time, as seen by the node where the device is.

panels.title: DRBD Read Rate (Top-5 Devices)
panels.description: Read rate of the 5 most active DRBD devices at each point in time, as seen by the node where the device is.

panels.title: DRBD Versions
panels.description: DRBD kernel module (kmod) and drbd-utils (utils) versions reported by drbd-reactor, and the loaded module version with its build suffix (module, from /sys/module/drbd/version via the agent) on each node. kmod drops the build suffix, so use module to tell builds apart. module is empty while the agent on the node is not Ready.

targets.expr: max by (node, kmod, utils, version) (drbd_version{node=~"$node"} * on(node) group_left(version) max by (node, version) (sds_drbd_module_info{node=~"$node"})) or on(node) max by (node, kmod, utils) (drbd_version{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: DRBD Resources by Node
panels.description: Number of DRBD resources configured on each node. In the new control plane a DRBD resource is one replica (RVR).

panels.title: Controller: Current Metrics Collector Duration P90
panels.description: Duration of SDS current metrics collector runs. Use this together with Prometheus scrape duration if the /metrics target becomes slow. Controller only: the current metrics collector runs in the leader controller; agents are covered by the scrape panels below.

panels.title: Controller: Current Metrics Collector Objects
panels.description: Number of objects processed by the current metrics collector by kind. Controller only: the current metrics collector runs in the leader controller; agents are covered by the scrape panels below. Absent after a failed run, like every other current metric.

panels.title: Controller: Current Metrics Collector Errors per Minute
panels.description: Failed current metrics collector runs per minute (rate over $__rate_interval times 60). Any non-zero value means current metrics were not exported on some scrapes. Controller only: the current metrics collector runs in the leader controller; agents are covered by the scrape panels below.

panels.title: Controller: Prometheus Scrape Duration
panels.description: Prometheus-side scrape duration of the controller /metrics endpoint, per controller pod. Covers the full endpoint, including the current metrics collector. Controller only; agent and drbd-reactor targets are in Agent / DRBD Scrape Duration by Node.

panels.title: Controller: Current Metrics Collector Duration Bands
panels.description: Completed collector runs: healthy <=0.25s, slow 0.25-1s, too slow >1s. Each bar is an increase over $__rate_interval, which is wider than the bar step, so adjacent bars overlap in time: do not sum bars to get a total, read the trend instead. Controller only: the current metrics collector runs in the leader controller; agents are covered by the scrape panels below.

panels.title: Controller: Current Metrics Up
panels.description: 1 when the last current metrics collection in the leader controller succeeded, 0 when it failed (no other current metric is exported then). No series means no leader exports current metrics (alert D8SdsReplicatedVolumeCurrentMetricsUnavailable).

panels.title: Scrape Targets Up by Job
panels.description: Scrape targets that are up, by job: controller pods, agent metrics and drbd-reactor on every node, plus the number of agent pods the DaemonSet should run. agent or drbd below expected means some nodes export no metrics: an agent target disappears while the agent pod is not Ready, a drbd-reactor target reports up=0 when it does not respond.

panels.title: Agent / DRBD Scrape Duration by Node
panels.description: Prometheus-side scrape duration of the agent and drbd-reactor targets by node. A missing line means the node exported no metrics at that time.

panels.title: Series per Scrape by Job (All Nodes)
panels.description: Samples returned by one scrape, summed over all targets of each job (all nodes for agent and drbd-reactor): the number of series each component adds to Prometheus. drbd-reactor grows with the number of replicas and their peers; agent is mostly Go and controller-runtime metrics (about 440 per node) and does not grow with the number of volumes.
